title: People sterilized under the eugenic sterilization laws of the United States, by state
description: Bar chart, people sterilized under state laws passed from 1907 to 1937. California 20,108; Virginia 8,300; North Carolina 6,851; Michigan 3,786; Georgia 3,284; Kansas 3,032; Indiana 2,424; Minnesota 2,350; the other 24 states with laws 15,235. Total 65,370. Data: Lombardo, Journal of Law, Medicine and Ethics, 2023, from Lombardo, Three Generations, No Imbeciles, 2008.
heading: STERILIZED UNDER STATE EUGENIC LAWS

source.container: Paul A. Lombardo, "Republicans, Democrats, & Doctors: The Lawmakers Who Wrote Sterilization Laws," Journal of Law, Medicine & Ethics 51 (2023), Table I
